title: Colorful shower curtain for Dr. who fans!
text: Colorful shower curtain for Dr. who fans!. The color and graphics of this shower curtain are good but the material it's made of it very thin. I would advise using it with a clear shower curtain liner. The price was very reasonable. We bought it for a college graduate who loves Doctor Who. Haven't received any feedback from him yet.
